title: Thirty Fay | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Thirty Fay — a house in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. 10 guests · 5 bedrooms · 3.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Thirty Fay' where luxury, entertainment, and unforgettable memories come together for the ultimate 30A getaway. Designed for families and groups who want more than just a place to stay, this stunning five-bedroom home with a bunk room features a private pool, basketball court, six-seater golf cart, and six adult bikes, creating a vacation experience that is truly one of a kind. Whether you're spending your mornings on the court, afternoons by the pool, or evenings exploring 30A, Thirty Fay was built for making memories together.Inside, you'll find bright, inviting living spaces filled with coastal charm and modern comforts. The open-concept layout makes gathering effortless, whether you're enjoying slow mornings with coffee, preparing meals in the fully equipped kitchen, or relaxing together after a day in the sun. Each bedroom provides a peaceful retreat, while the bunk room is sure to become a favorite hangout for younger guests.Step outside and discover what truly sets Thirty Fay apart. The private backyard is more than just a pool area it's your own personal vacation playground. Cool off in the sparkling private pool, lounge under the Florida sunshine, or head to the basketball court, where friendly competition takes center stage. Whether you're organizing a family tournament, challenging the kids to a shooting contest, or enjoying an evening game after a day at the beach, the court creates the kind of moments guests talk about long after vacation ends.When you're ready to explore, take advantage of the included six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes. Cruise to nearby beach accesses, discover local restaurants and boutiques, or spend the day exploring the charming beach communities that make 30A so special.Whether you're planning a family reunion, a friends' retreat, or a multi-generational vacation, Thirty Fay delivers the perfect mix of luxury, relaxation, and entertainment for an unforgettable stay along 30A.HOME HIGHLIGHTSShort Bike Ride to the BeachBasketball Court in Backyard6 Seater Golf CartPrivate Pool & SpaPool heating available for $50 per day (Pool & Spa Heated Together)Private Covered Patio with Outdoor Seating6 Adult bikesClose to Seaside & Grayton BeachFully Equipped Gourmet KitchenSmart TVsOutdoor Built-in Gas Grill & Outdoor Seating AreaOutdoor ShowerBeach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Toys & Coolers4 Dedicated Parking SpotsFull Sized Washer and DryerFenced in YardBunk BedsEspresso MachineDesk in HomeACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 10FIRST FLOORBedroom #1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower & Soaking TubBedroom #2: Twin/Double BunkHalf Bathroom-Living Room-Dining Room-Laundry RoomSECOND FLOORBedroom #3: KingBedroom #4: QueenBedroom #5: Double Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboJack & Jill BathroomWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee GroundsCoffee Filters2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGFour driveway parking spaces available.Included are 6 bicycles (adult) & 6 seater golf cart for your convenience.BEACH ACCESSThree public beach accesses a short distance from the home:1. Gulfview Heights Beach Access is located 3 miles east of the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A (Gulf Place). Turn south off Scenic 30A by Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street, then 1/4 mile to the gulf. This access has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season.2. Ed Walline Regional Beach Access is located at the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, just across the street from Gulf Place rentals, shopping, and dining. This access is ADA accessible, and has two picnic shelters, parking, restrooms, and beach wheelchairs and lifeguards during peak season. Ed Walline Regional Access is unique among SoWal accesses with a two-story viewing platform overlooking the beach and gulf - a great place to spot surfers and dolphins.3. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. It may be the most well hidden access in SoWal.BLUE MOUNTAIN COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSBlue Mountain is a laid-back coastal gem celebrated for its natural beauty, relaxed pace, and small-town charm. As the highest elevation along Scenic Highway 30A, it offers scenic dune views, peaceful beaches, and some of the most stunning sunsets on the Gulf.The area is dotted with beloved local spots, from homemade ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery to casual bites at Red Fish Taco and slow-smoked favorites from Blue Mabel Smokehouse. Locally owned shops, bike paths, and friendly gathering places add to the community feel, making Blue Mountain the perfect escape for those seeking an authentic, unhurried 30A experience.Just a short bike or golf cart ride away is Gulf Place. A beach neighborhood where inspiration waits around every corner. Whether you’re a beach bum, foodie, shopper, or art lover, you’ll find your passion here. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach.When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience.Activities for every interest abound in Gulf Place. Unwind with a reflexology massage or enzyme facial at Awakening Wellness Organic Spa. Explore the palm tree-lined streets and neighborhood shops at Gulf Place Town Center. Ultimately, the best part of beach life is kicking off your shoes and feeling the sand between your toes. For sunset strolls and inspiring views, drift down to the Ed Walline Regional Beach Access. With ample parking, restrooms, bike racks and proximity to lifeguards in season, it couldn’t be more welcoming.Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 50 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a 40 minute drive.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid driver's license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.*Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day (Pool & Spa Heated Together). Must be heated for duration of stay. If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi.*Home must remain pet free.*Garage is not for guest use.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
